facts.business: Gayatri Highways Limited is an infrastructure company engaged in the development, operation, and maintenance of highway projects through Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs), primarily earning revenue from toll collections and operations & maintenance services.

auditor.name: M/s. PRSV & Co. LLP, Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualifications include: (1) Overstatement of other equity by Rs. 4,476.51 Lakhs and understatement of liabilities by Rs. 4,476.51 Lakhs due to unconfirmed write-off of ZISL payable to Gayatri Projects Limited; (2) Overstatement of other equity by Rs. 339.61 Lakhs and understatement of liabilities by Rs. 339.61 Lakhs due to discrepancy in loan confirmation from GPL; (3) Inability to comment on carrying value of term loan and interest payable to IL&FS Financial Services Limited due to lack of balance confirmation; (4) Non-provision of interest of Rs. 1,720.20 Lakhs on IL&FS loan for FY 2023-26; (5) Non-impairment of investments/loans in Cyberabad Expressways Limited (Rs. 4,483.60 Lakhs) and Hyderabad Expressways Limited (Rs. 462.82 Lakhs) despite negative net worth, leading to understatement of loss and overstatement of equity by Rs. 4,946.42 Lakhs.

key_risks: Default in repayment of term loan and interest to IL&FS Financial Services Limited
Non-provision of interest on outstanding borrowings leading to understatement of liabilities
Significant impairment risk in jointly controlled entities (CEL and HEL) due to negative net worth
Discrepancies in related party balances with Gayatri Projects Limited
Dependence on arbitration/litigation outcomes for recovery of receivables in CEL
Negative net worth of the company indicating financial distress
Subsidiary (Indore Dewas Tollways Limited) under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
facts.related_party_note: Significant related party transactions and balances with Gayatri Projects Limited (promoter), including Zero Interest Subordinate Loan (ZISL) write-back discrepancies and loan balance mismatches. Investments, loans, and receivables in jointly controlled entities Cyberabad Expressways Limited and Hyderabad Expressways Limited. The company has not impaired these exposures despite negative net worth in CEL.
